title: The Cherry Tree
subject: English
summary: “The Cherry Tree” is a beautiful story about a young boy named Rakesh who plants a cherry seed in his grandfather's garden. At first, he forgets about the seed, but later a tiny plant begins to grow. Rakesh and his grandfather take care of it and protect it from insects, animals and other dangers. Slowly, the little plant grows into a beautiful cherry tree. One day, Rakesh enjoys sitting under its branches and watching nature around him. His grandfather explains that trees give us happiness and make the world more beautiful. The story teaches us that we should be patient, care for nature and understand the importance of planting and protecting trees.
